title: Workload, Burnout and Team Practices That Help
before: Burnout is mostly a work problem, not a personal one.

turns.text: Burnout isn't a personal failing. It's what happens when the demands of work stay higher than people's ability to recover, for too long. In this course, you'll focus on what you can change about how your team's work is set up.

guidance.text: Notice where extra work goes on your team. It often follows skill and goodwill, and that's exactly why it needs watching.
Think of one thing your team could share, delay or drop this month.
Making the case upward is part of the job. Bring the numbers and one clear ask.
